name: Slideshow Panel Blinds
description: Full-screen image slideshow where colored panels slide across like blinds to cover and reveal each next image, driven by wheel, touch drag or arrow buttons.
contents: Stack of colored blind panels used for transitions
Scroll hint text with previous and next round arrow buttons
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer drag move to previous or next slide through GSAP Observer
Colored panels slide in alternating directions, then open to reveal the next slide which scales in
Container stays hidden until images are preloaded
editableByProps: Images, number and colors of blind panels, background and text colors
Timing, easing, stagger and scale of the transition
Scroll sensitivity, hint text and navigation button visibility, size and colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the arrow glyphs of the navigation buttons
needsCodeEdit.where: ← and → buttons in the showNavButtons block
decoPanels.forEach blocks using xPercent in the navigate function

fixed: Captures wheel, touch and pointer input over the container through GSAP Observer
Container has full viewport height and starts hidden until images are preloaded
